name: Katana MRP
summary: Cloud manufacturing and inventory platform for product businesses. Live inventory control, production scheduling and order syncing across your sales channels — know exactly what to make and when.
best_for: product makers and small manufacturers who need live inventory, production scheduling and multi-channel order sync in one cloud platform
skip_if: you're a simple reseller who doesn't manufacture (a plain inventory tool is cheaper), or your volume is too low to justify the add-on-driven real cost
honest_knock: The $299 headline is the floor. Core is billed on top per delivered sales order and per extra location, at rates Katana no longer publishes, and production routings and traceability are paid add-ons at $199 and $249 a month, which are exactly the features most manufacturers need. It's genuinely capable manufacturing software; just get a quote on your own order volume and price the add-ons you need, not the base plan.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-23) A Free plan covering 30 SKUs with unlimited users, integrations and locations plus all Katana features, add-ons and API access, then Core starting at $299/month with unlimited SKUs, users and integrations, one inventory location and 24/7 support, and an Advantage tier on custom pricing that adds custom integrations, dashboards and automations with a dedicated Solutions Engineer. The $299 is a floor, not a bill: Katana's own FAQ says Core is usage-based, billed on the number of sales orders delivered at a lower per-unit cost as volume grows, plus a charge for each location beyond the one included, but the pricing page no longer publishes those per-order or per-location rates, so the real figure comes from sales. The add-ons are priced separately: Manufacturing Management (routings and insights) $199/mo, Traceability via batch or serial numbers $249/mo and Warehouse Management $149/mo; a Shop Floor app is listed as an add-on without a price. Onboarding is a $2,000 option on Core and included on Advantage. Annual billing is not a discount: the FAQ says it includes "a small premium" because Katana absorbs usage swings, and usage more than 20% over your estimate reopens the price.
